feeds.title: Western Fictioneers Blog
feeds.description: Official Blog of the Western Fictioneers, Professional Authors of Traditional Western Novels and Short Stories.

feeds.title: Western Fiction Review
feeds.description: I've been a reader and collector of western fiction, mainly from series. Sometime ago I was persuaded to write reviews and these are now appearing here. Along with these reviews you'll also find interviews with authors and cover artists.

feeds.title: True West Magazine
feeds.description: True West captures the history of the American frontier through authentic literary and heritage travel narratives in the spirit of the Wild West.

feeds.title: Westerns All'Italiana
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to the preservation, investigation and all things related to European films and personnel involved with the western genre.

feeds.title: Rough Edges
feeds.description: Rough Edges writes about fiction books, movies and other matters of western-related interest.

feeds.title: 50 Westerns From The 50s Blog
feeds.description: The blog by author Toby focuses on Western Ficiton based in the 50's.

feeds.title: Henry's Western Round-up
feeds.description: Henry's Western Round-up is a weekly on-line report on Western movie and TV production, books, screenings, live events, home video, and other matters of western-related interest.

feeds.title: Bear Alley
feeds.description: Freelance author and editor for the past 20 years. My interests are old British comics, books and magazines... and that's what you'll find here.

feeds.title: Gary Dobbs at the Tainted Archive
feeds.description: As a writer I write westerns for the Black Horse Western imprint using the name Jack Martin. Under my own name I am responsible for several novels including the popular Granny Smith series. I also write none fiction historical books for pen and sword books.

feeds.title: Davy Crockett's Almanack of Mystery, Adventure and The Wild West
feeds.description: When not blogging, I write mysteries and historical adventure. I am the proud (and mighty dang lucky) recipient of the Mystery Writers of America 2011 Robert L. Fish Award. My AHMM story 'The Continental Opposite' was nominated for a Shamus award and selected for The Best American Mystery Stories 2016.

feeds.title: Westerns on the Blog
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to American western movies.

feeds.title: James D. Best
feeds.description: James Best is the author of the bestselling Steve Dancy Tales: The Shopkeeper, Leadville, Murder at Thumb Butte, The Return, Jenny's Revenge, and Crossing the Animas. His other novels include Tempest at Dawn, The Shut Mouth Society, and Deluge.

feeds.title: Historical Novels Society
feeds.description: A guide to historical novels and authors of historical and western fiction; books organized by setting, with information on literary style and genre.

feeds.title: Broken Trails
feeds.description: I was born in North London but moved to Orpington, Kent. I write westerns under the name of Jack Giles that are published by Robert Hale's Black Horse Western brand. Having brought up six children and seen them married off -as a result we now have 15 grandchildren - we now live in Kent.

feeds.title: Writing For A Brand
feeds.description: Peter Brandvold is an American western fiction author, who has written published novels.Born in North Dakota, bestselling western novelist Peter Brandvold has penned over seventy fast-action westerns under his own name and his pen name, Frank Leslie.

feeds.title: Bloggincurly
feeds.description: Thoughts about Western fiction, the West, Western Writers, Books, and other subjects, including excerpts from my novels, and short stories.

feeds.title: The Culbin Trail
feeds.description: Ian Parnham has written 36 novels for the Black Horse Western series and 6 for the Avalon Western series.

feeds.title: Confessions of a Writer of Westerns
feeds.description: Covering a wide range of western and writing topics. Neil Waring is the author of more than a dozen books, photographer, and historian.
